morphology.look_here_first: Start with the leaves: clasping coneflower has smooth/glabrous sessile leaves whose rounded bases visibly clasp the stem. The yellow rays often have a reddish-brown basal eye around the raised dark cone.
diagnostic_traits: sessile leaves with rounded clasping bases
yellow rays often with dark reddish-brown basal eye
